pro_tip.label: Pro tip
pro_tip.degrease_body: Clean the frame surface first with a degreaser for optimal adhesion.
pro_tip.visible_body: Place the Frame-ID in plain sight — preferably just below the seat post. That makes the QR easy to scan.
pro_tip.deterrent_body: A visible Frame-ID immediately tells thieves your bike is protected and registered.
